title: Saudi-led coalition says Houthis fired ballistic missile at Riyadh

blocks.text: RIYADH, Saudi Arabia – The Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen’s Houthis said Saturday that the Iran-backed group fired a ballistic missile at Riyadh at dawn, after a fire broke out near the Saudi capital’s international airport. Firefighters extinguished a blaze on a fuel tank with the logo of the Saudi oil giant Aramco at a fuel depot
